title: AIVS Provenance Extension 1.0
description: Property-extension on any STIX object: who reviewed it at the ISAC, and how it was generated. The reviewer fields are written by the server when the ISAC validates; a submitter that sets them is refused.

human_reviewed_by_ref.description: The ISAC operator identity that validated the object. Server-written.

reviewed_at.description: When the ISAC validated the object. Server-written.

generated_by.description: The submitter's statement of what produced the object (a tool, a model, a person's role). A claim, not the source type the server derives from the principal.

factors.description: The inputs the submitter weighed, as short labels.
